admission.justification: Row materialization and boundary-span reuse in the table owners cooperate with blob-line reuse in the conversion/content owners; three deterministic regression proofs separately protect scan counts, constructed-row boundaries and two-instance blob reuse with exact byte/refusal semantics.

applicability: Materializing table rows from unfenced Markdown lines and reusing LF-only blob lines for line-count and anchor-content reads in one conversion-owned CodeObjects instance.
conditions: The boundary positions belong to the same line whose cell offsets are derived.
Cached byte lines are the unmodified LF-only split of the blob named by the key.
Line-count and resolved range-content requests share the same CodeObjects instance.
exclusions: No persistent parse store, cross-instance blob-line reuse, whole worklist/result memo or new tree-enumeration behavior is promised.
Whole-file anchors continue to hash raw bytes without needing a split.
No elapsed-time budget, incremental-memory bound or final-cut RSS improvement is established by deterministic reuse.
statement: Table materialization scans each eligible pipe-bearing unfenced line at most once, each blob is split once per conversion-owned CodeObjects instance, and reused byte lines and divider facts preserve conversion and table-boundary results.
